note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Aimed Shot
spells.description: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 166. Aimed Shot shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

spells.name: Arcane Resistance
spells.description: Increases Arcane resistance by 120.

spells.name: Arcane Shot
spells.description: An instant shot that causes 217 Arcane damage.

spells.name: Aspect of the Beast
spells.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a beast, becoming untrackable and increasing Melee Attack Power by 110. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Cheetah
spells.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a cheetah, increasing movement speed by 30%. If the hunter takes damage, he will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Hawk
spells.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a hawk, increasing Ranged Attack Power by 120. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Monkey
spells.description: The hunter takes on the aspects of a monkey, increasing chance to dodge by 8%. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Pack
spells.description: The hunter and group members within 30 yards take on the aspects of a pack of cheetahs, increasing movement speed by 30%. If a pack member takes damage, they will be dazed for 4 sec. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Aspect of the Wild
spells.description: The hunter and all party and raid members within 30 yards take on the aspect of the wild, increasing Nature resistance by 60. Only one Aspect can be active at a time.

spells.name: Auto Shot
spells.description: Automatically shoots the target until cancelled.

spells.name: Beast Lore
spells.description: Gather information about the target beast. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor, any special resistances, and diet.

spells.name: Bestial Wrath
spells.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

spells.name: Bite
spells.description: Bite the enemy, causing 81 to 99 damage.

spells.name: Call Pet
spells.description: Summons your pet to you.

spells.name: Charge
spells.description: Charges an enemy, immobilizes it for 1 sec, and adds 490 melee attack power to the boar's next attack.

spells.name: Claw
spells.cost: Pet: Bear, Bird of Prey, Carrion Bird, Cat, Crab, Raptor, Scorpid
spells.description: Claw the enemy, causing 43 to 59 damage.

spells.name: Concussive Shot
spells.description: Dazes the target, slowing movement speed by 50% for 4 sec.

spells.name: Counterattack
spells.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 55 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

spells.name: Cower
spells.description: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

spells.name: Dash
spells.description: Increases movement speed by 80% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Demoralizing Screech
spells.description: Blasts a single enemy for 24 to 42 damage and lowers the melee attack power of all enemies in melee range by 204 for 30 sec.

spells.name: Deterrence
spells.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Disengage
spells.description: Attempts to disengage from the target by reducing threat. More effective than Disengage (Rank 2). Disables auto-attack.

spells.name: Dismember
spells.description: Viciously bites enemy appendages for 50 to 58 damage and reduces the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

spells.name: Dismiss Pet
spells.description: Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.

spells.name: Distracting Shot
spells.description: Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 5).

spells.name: Dive
spells.cost: Pet: Bat, Bird of Prey, Carrion Bird, Wind Serpent
spells.description: Increases movement speed by 80% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Dust Cloud
spells.description: Your tallstrider kicks up an abrasive cloud of dust, reducing the target's Armor by 505 for 30 sec.

spells.name: Eagle Eye
spells.description: Zooms in the hunter's vision. Only usable outdoors. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Enchanted Flare
spells.description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.

spells.name: Explosive Trap
spells.description: Place a Fire trap that explodes when an enemy approaches, causing 208 to 264 Fire damage and 330 additional Fire damage over 20 sec to all within 10 yards. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Eyes of the Beast
spells.description: Take direct control of your pet and see through its eyes for 2 min.

spells.name: Feed Pet
spells.description: Feed your pet the selected item. Feeding your pet increases happiness. Using food close to the pet's level will have a better result.

spells.name: Feign Death
spells.description: Feign death which may trick enemies into ignoring you. Lasts 6 min. If not cancelled, after 6 min you will actually die.

spells.name: Fire Resistance
spells.description: Increases Fire resistance by 120.

spells.name: Flare
spells.description: Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area for 30 sec.

spells.name: Freezing Trap
spells.description: Place a Frost trap that freezes the first enemy that approaches, preventing all action for up to 20 sec. Any damage caused will break the ice. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Frost Resistance
spells.description: Increases Frost resistance by 120.

spells.name: Frost Trap
spells.description: Place a Frost trap that creates an ice slick around itself for 30 sec when the first enemy approaches it. All enemies within 10 yards will be slowed by 60% while in the area of effect. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Frost trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Furious Howl
spells.description: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 138. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Great Stamina
spells.description: Stamina increased by 40.

spells.name: Growl
spells.description: Taunt the target, increasing the likelihood the creature will focus attacks on you.

spells.name: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: Places the Hunter's Mark on the target, increasing the Ranged Attack Power of all attackers against that target by 71. In addition, the target of this ability can always be seen by the hunter whether it stealths or turns invisible. The target also appears on the mini-map. Lasts for 2 min.

spells.name: Immolation Trap
spells.description: Place a Fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Only one Fire trap can be active at a time.

spells.name: Intimidation
spells.description: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

spells.name: Lacerate
spells.description: Wounds the target causing them to bleed for 406 damage over 21 sec.

spells.name: Lightning Breath
spells.description: Breathes lightning, instantly dealing 86 to 98 Nature damage to a single target.

spells.name: Mend Pet
spells.description: Heals your pet 245 health every second while you focus. Lasts 5 sec.

spells.name: Mine!
spells.description: Grabs an enemy's weapon with its talons, causing 41 to 47 damage and disarming them for 4 sec.

spells.name: Mongoose Bite
spells.description: Counterattack the enemy for melee weapon damage plus 57. Can only be performed after you dodge.

spells.name: Multi-Shot
spells.description: Fires several missiles, hitting 3 targets. Multi-Shot shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.

spells.name: Natural Armor
spells.description: Armor increased by 1,000.

spells.name: Nature Resistance
spells.description: Increases Nature resistance by 120.

spells.name: Pinch
spells.description: Pinches an enemy's legs for 88 to 102 damage and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

spells.name: Prowl
spells.description: Puts your pet in stealth mode, but slows its movement speed by 40%. The first attack from stealth receives a 50% bonus to damage. Lasts until cancelled.

spells.name: Rapid Fire
spells.description: Increases ranged and melee attack speed by 40% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Raptor Strike
spells.description: A strong attack that deals melee weapon damage plus 70.

spells.name: Revive Pet
spells.description: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its health.

spells.name: Savage Rend
spells.description: Slash an enemy with razor talons, causing the target to Bleed for 156 damage over 18 sec.

spells.name: Scare Beast
spells.description: Scares a beast, causing it to run in fear for up to 20 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one beast can be feared at a time.

spells.name: Scatter Shot
spells.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

spells.name: Scorpid Poison
spells.description: Inflicts 25 Nature damage over 10 sec. Effect can stack up to 5 times on a single target.

spells.name: Scorpid Sting
spells.description: Stings the target, reducing the target's chance to hit with attacks by 2% for 20 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Serpent Sting
spells.description: Stings the target, causing 555 Nature damage over 15 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Shadow Resistance
spells.description: Increases Shadow resistance by 120.

spells.name: Shell Shield
spells.description: Reduces all damage your pet takes by 50% and increases the time between your pet's attacks by 60%, but deals more damage with each attack. Lasts 12 sec.

spells.name: Sniper Shot
spells.description: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 295.

spells.name: Strider Kick
spells.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.

spells.name: Summon Hawk
spells.description: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 108 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

spells.name: Swipe
spells.description: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 20 to 22 damage.

spells.name: Tame Beast
spells.description: Begins taming a beast to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the beast for 20 sec. If you lose the beast's attention for any reason, the taming process will fail. Once tamed, the beast will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

spells.name: Tendon Rip
spells.description: Tears at an enemy's legs for 60 damage over 9 sec and reduces movement speed by 50% for 9 sec.

spells.name: Thunderstomp
spells.description: Shakes the ground with thundering force, doing 122 to 142 Nature damage to all enemies within 8 yards.

spells.name: Track Beasts
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Demons
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby demons on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Dragonkin
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby dragonkin on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Elementals
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby elementals on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Giants
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby giants on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Hidden
spells.description: Increases stealth detection and shows hidden units within detection range on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Humanoids
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Track Undead
spells.description: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap. Only one form of tracking can be active at a time.

spells.name: Tranquilizing Shot
spells.description: Attempts to remove 1 Frenzy effect from an enemy creature.

spells.name: Trickster's Dance
spells.description: Increases your pet's chance to Dodge by 50% and decreases the time between your pet's attacks by 30%. Lasts 12 sec.

spells.name: Trueshot Aura
spells.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 50. Lasts 30 min.

spells.name: Viper Sting
spells.description: Stings the target, draining 1,108 mana over 8 sec. Only one Sting per Hunter can be active on any one target.

spells.name: Volley
spells.description: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 112 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every 1 sec for 6 sec.

spells.name: Web
spells.description: Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 52 Nature damage over 4 sec.

spells.name: Wing Clip
spells.description: Inflicts 50 damage and reduces the enemy target's movement speed by 60% for 10 sec.
